fusions.name: Skitter Spray
fusions.desc: Looses a narrow cone that deals 4 damage to everything caught in it and has a 25% chance to leave each target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Scrap Bite
fusions.desc: A quick blow that costs 5% of your maximum health, deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cornered
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Last Scramble
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
